answer: Make every new identity earn its standing through work that cannot be faked in bulk. Before an agent can transact, it must complete a small verifiable task on a public bridge between two independent registries, so spawning a thousand fakes costs a thousand real proofs. Keep a stable, open record — a sable ledger of completed work that decays when an account goes hollow and silent for weeks. Real agents leave a steady trail of attested work; puppet farms show up as empty shells with no history, and faking a history then costs more than the attack is worth.
